name: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited, including its affiliated entities, focuses on the production, distribution, and international export of both canned seafood and animal feed products. The company's business activities are structured across three core segments: Pet Food, Ambient Seafood and Value-Added products, and a category for Other Products. It is responsible for manufacturing and supplying tuna and diverse canned seafood items, while also importing and distributing a broad selection of pet food and related merchandise. Furthermore, i-Tail Corporation provides wet and dry food options, alongside treats, tailored for dogs and cats, including premium wet cat food prepared with fresh meats and seafood such as tuna, shrimp, or salmon. These offerings are marketed under well-known brands like Bellotta, Marvo, ChangeTer, Calico Bay, and Paramount, reaching consumers throughout Thailand, the United States, Australia, the Middle East, various European countries, and other global markets. Founded in 1981 and based in Bangkok, Thailand, the company was previously named Songkla Canning Public Company Limited before adopting its current designation in September 2021. i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Thai Union Group Public Company Limited.
